scope: Complete independent article reading of 37 S/W/P workflows in English and French, followed by primary implementation comparisons and the recorded corrections. 34 unchanged variants receive independent fact/language review here. The 40 variants with newly authored passages are assessed independently by root in the separate delta registry; this reviewer does not approve their own writing. Screenshots and runtime/reader acceptance remain separate.
